Retain k algebraically closed, trivially valued, characteristic zero and of arbitrary cardinality; X smooth integral projective of dimension n>=1; L an actual nef rational line bundle, theta=c1(L), canonical actual reference zero; C=X^an and generic trivial valuation v0. Measures remain Radon measures on the original carrier. It is not a completion or pullback-defined cone. G0 is used only in its exact granted actual-ample domain. The supplied drafts132–135 and native121 are reconstructed rather than accepted by label.

Multiplication by generators of an actual ample difference preserves each FS scalar exactly, including poles: a zero-weight generating system has scalar zero at every analytic point. Thus genuine potentials embed in a common sufficiently large actual ample cone, giving supremum u(v0), finite divisorial values and all-point divisorial determination. For nef L, PSH(theta)=intersection_{epsilon>0 rational}PSH(theta+epsilon h). Conversely, finite continuous fixed-ample approximants shifted by positive delta form one directed defining net: choose smaller epsilon and delta, then use a compact open cover to put a late approximant below the finite continuous minimum of two old shifted functions. This avoids strict comparisons at common poles. Normalized approaching ample cones are closed compact subsets of one common ample divisorial space; their intersection is the entire compact normalized nef cone, including arbitrary-cardinality nets. Genuine decreasing closure and usc envelopes follow. Zero is its minimal reference. Continuity of nef envelopes is not asserted.

The general printed BJv4 Lemma4.6 fails. Let compact K consist of isolated q and isolated p_j tending to p_infinity. F_n consists of extended-continuous functions equal to c at q, -infinity at p_n, and c-m elsewhere, m>=1. Each family is constant-stable. Increasing m at c=0 gives the same endpoint g, zero at q and -infinity elsewhere; this constant outer family has parameters1/n->0. But after a term from F_n, its permanent hole forces every later term of a decreasing original-family net to remain in F_n. A common later index prevents mixing different families, so its parameter cannot tend to zero. This refutes the abstract lemma only, not specialized algebraic closure.

A bounded genuine theta-potential lies in actual ample PSH(theta+h); its constant bounds prove actual ample finite energy. Only then is the published E~1 signed pairing used. Expand the actual metric pair (theta+h,u)-(h,0) into genuine ample products. Positive ample perturbations are finite signed-measure polynomials in epsilon; their constant coefficient gives the positive bounded nef product independently of auxiliaries. At a PL/model stage its raw measure is sum_F b_F product_i(theta_i,X+D_i)|_F delta_vF, with b_F=ord_F(t) and v_F=ord_F|k(X)/b_F. Fundamental cycles and central multiplicities are retained. Generated local compatibility uses the exactly scoped ample contact collar, including its reference term, before signed expansion. Arbitrary individual singular currents are not assumed.

Ample strict-winning locality restricted to the fixed Borel set {a>b} is an exact polynomial identity. A Vandermonde system forces each signed coefficient to vanish, giving bounded nef Borel locality. No weak limit is passed through an indicator. Define raw E(u)=(n+1)^{-1}sum_{r=0}^n integral u T_u^r theta^{n-r}, V=theta^n, E(0)=0 and E(u+c)=E(u)+Vc. The entire intrinsic space is defined by E(u)=inf_k E(max(u,-k))>-infinity. Unbounded endpoints are not assumed to belong to E~1.

For normalized u<=0, C_u=-E(u), u_k=max(u,-k), define the original operator M(u)=lim_k1_{u>-k}M(u_k). Borel locality makes these restrictions increasing. Positive energy integrands give integral(-u_k)M(u_k)<=(n+1)C_u and M(u_k){u<=-k}<=(n+1)C_u/k. Consequently the limit is Radon, has full raw mass V, annihilates u's poles, and satisfies ||M(u_k)-M(u)||_TV<=2(n+1)C_u/k. Constants and bounded reference floors give the same operator. For an arbitrary decreasing intrinsic E1 net, subtract a common upper bound; the endpoint energy supplies a uniform floor estimate. First choose a floor level, then an original index. This proves weak continuity against every original continuous test without replacing the net by a sequence or a smaller observable space.

For normalized bounded a,b, expansion of nonpositive mixed heights and concavity give integral(-b)M(a)<=2^n(C_a+C_b). Passing actual floors first by total variation against bounded Borel weights and then by countable monotone convergence proves this for every intrinsic E1 pair. Every output therefore integrates every intrinsic test.

Only for V>0 use e=E/V, m=M/V, I(a,b)=integral(a-b)(m(b)-m(a)), J_b(a)=e(b)-e(a)+integral(a-b)m(b), and J(a)=sup a-e(a). Actual ample bounded I/J and Holder inequalities pass through nef coefficient limits; their constants depend only on n. Ordered pairs satisfy I(a,b)<=n(n+1)(e(a)-e(b)) for a>=b. Relative-J control gives uniform weighted floor tails delta_k+C_n[n(n+1)delta_k]^{2^-n}B^{1-2^-n}, with delta_k=e(v_k)-e(v)->0 and bounded normalized J-values. This proves fixed and simultaneous weighted floor convergence in total variation, passing the inequalities to the entire intrinsic space.

For original decreasing nets, Holder control gives convergence of integrals of bounded discontinuous v_k. Complete primary Lemma7.22 then gives weighted weak convergence: weak positive measures, increasing nonnegative lsc weights and convergence of weight integrals imply that each cluster dominates the endpoint weighted measure; equal total masses force equality. Directed open superlevels and Radon compact approximation justify its arbitrary-cardinality step. Uniform tails give v_i M(u_i)->vM(u). Polarization of subset averages identifies positive actual common-class mixed floor limits, full mass, integrability, locality and weighted arbitrary-net continuity. Full mass and displaced maxima give comparison. Unrelated unbounded intrinsic nonample classes are not silently supplied.

Ample continuous-obstacle envelopes decrease to genuine nef envelopes in a common bounded ample domain. Energy and measure polynomial coefficients converge. Ample orthogonality supplies the supporting inequality F(g)-F(f)<=integral(g-f)M(Pf). Bounded uniform metric continuity and continuous majorants decreasing to an arbitrary intrinsic E1 base pass both signs to E(P(u+tf)). Floor total variation gives M(P(u+tf))->M(u), so both outer derivatives equal integral fM(u) for every original continuous f. No continuity of nef envelopes is presumed.

For -k<=b<=0, bounded height coefficients with m=n+1-l theta entries lie between -mk theta^{n-l}h^l and zero. This gives uniform approaching-ample energy convergence on bounded floor ranges. Genuine coordinatewise floor continuity and infimum over floors prove weak energy usc and compact normalized energy sublevels. Positive expansion gives C(au)<=K_n a^2 C(u), K_n=2^{n+1}, because the zero-reference term A_0 is zero.

For a raw mass-V target set D(mu)=sup_{u in intrinsic E1}(E(u)-integral u mu). Finite D is equivalent to integrability of every intrinsic test. Otherwise convex sums of normalized tests with bounded energy and integrals at least2^j produce an actual E1 limit with infinite integral. Quadratic scaling gives a sqrt(C) integral bound and explicit coercivity E(u)-integral u mu<=-C_u/2+D(mu)/a for a<=1/(2K_n). This bounds maximizing nets but does not alone establish attainment.

At V=0 all positive bounded top/common-class products, intrinsic top energies and top operators vanish. There is no probability normalization or automatic uniqueness.

notes.text:
Use n1's retained field, original smooth integral projective X, genuine numerical cone, entire intrinsic floor E1/operator, raw energy and mass, weighted arbitrary nets, both outer signs, weak energy usc and intrinsic targets. Assume the actual rational L is also big. Kodaira vanishing, Bertini, ample twisting and the intersection Euler polynomial are retained named classical premises with checked applications and explicit recursive limitations.

An actual Kodaira decomposition L=A+D exists, A ample rational and D effective rational Cartier. For a smooth very ample H, ample twisting bounds h0(H,mL|H) by O(m^{n-1}); big section growth and the restriction sequence give a section of mL-H for some m. Its divisor divided by m gives D and H/m gives A. Choose smooth ample H with H-K_X ample. Kodaira vanishing for mL+H identifies h0 with V m^n/n!+O(m^{n-1}); restriction to H has O(m^{n-1}) sections. The exact sequence sandwiches h0(mL), proving vol(L)=L^n=V>0. The primary characteristic-zero vanishing proof uses auxiliary finite-type descent and flat cohomology base change, not a countability restriction on the original field.

The polar barrier is intrinsic. For normalized genuine a<=0 define Cap_theta(B)=sup_{-1<=c<=0}m(c)(B), using probability notation only at positive V. At an a-floor, telescoping n mixed differences from M(0)=V delta_v0 and bounded integration by parts gives integral(-a_floor)m(c)<=n: each difference is a difference of integrals of -c in[0,1] against positive mixed mass-V measures. Countable floors give Cap{a<=-t}<=n/t. Locality and equal floor masses, together with t^nM(c_t/t)>=M(c_t), give C(c_s)/V<=1+integral_1^infinity t^n Cap{c<=-t}dt. For rational0<gamma<1/(n+1), b=1-(1-a)^gamma is genuine through decreasing convex chord majorants with slopes in[0,1] and constant left tails. Capacity decay O(t^-1/gamma) proves actual intrinsic E1 membership with the same poles. Intrinsic targets annihilate those poles. Also integral(-a_N)d tau<=c_gamma(1+N)^{1-gamma}(tau(C)+integral(-b)d tau), uniformly for outputs on an energy sublevel by n1's integrability estimate.

Take a=log||s_D||, genuine theta-psh by multiplying generators of A. Its poles are the support subset D^an, not valuations centered on D. Canonical zero remains the reference; D is only a proof device.

Positive mixed Dirichlet expansion proves I((1-t)c+td,c)<=t[1-(1-t)^n]I(d,c)<=nt^2 I(d,c); weighted floors extend it intrinsically. The published BJ7.33 intermediate statement omits t, whereas its proof retains it. The paper independently proves the corrected inequality.

For normalized intrinsic u choose integer q>max(2,1/gamma), N=m^q, t=m^{-(q-1)}, K=tN=m and R=K/(1-t). Put w_m=max((1-t)u+ta,-K), z_m=(1-t)u_R+t a_N. The scalar floor inequality gives z_m<=w_m<=(1-t)u_R. Supporting concavity bounds E((1-t)u_R)-E(u_R)<=t(n+1)C_u. Contraction and I/J control give J_{u_R}(z_m)<=C_n t^2(C_u/V+N). The barrier moment estimate gives E(z_m)-E(u_R)>=-c t(1+N)^{1-gamma}-C_n Vt^2(C_u/V+N). Both errors vanish since1-q gamma<0 and2-q<0. Hence E(w_m)->E(u). The same sandwich proves integral w_m tau->integral u tau for every prescribed finite family of intrinsic targets. No all-point convergence across D^an is claimed; those targets annihilate it.

For fixed rational t,K, rationalize a defining numerical FS net f_i before taking floors. The actual difference L-[(1-t)B_i+tD]=tA+(1-t)(L-B_i) is ample on a tail. Tensor original sections, the D-section and generators of this difference; the fixed-L scalar is exactly(1-t)f_i+ta. Its rational floor is genuine theta-psh and rational PL, using actual vertical-ideal blowups for truncated ideal logarithms. Closure of PL_R under arbitrary real maxima is not assumed. Bounded decreasing energy and decreasing-usc Radon integral continuity select actual rational PL-theta stages. Generic constants tend to zero, so normalization preserves the limits. This approximates every intrinsic E1 u in energy and any finite list of intrinsic target integrals; it does not assert all-point fixed-L regularization or PL-theta spanning all continuous tests.

Uniform derivatives retain the whole original test space. For an original PL_R test f and a bounded floor range, choose ample H large enough that f is a difference of fixed bounded genuine potentials in omega_r=theta+r h, r=1,...,n+1. The actual ample Holder inequality and I_omega(a,b)<=2||a-b|| give |integral f(M_omega(a)-M_omega(b))|<=c_{f,k,r}sqrt(||a-b||). Exact degree-n interpolation gives M_theta(a)=sum_{r=1}^{n+1}(-1)^{r-1}binom(n+1,r)M_{theta+r h}(a). For q_t=P_theta(u+tf), common floors differ by at most|t|||f|| and have uniform raw total-variation tails O(1/k), including the checked generic-constant shift. First choose k, then t. The supporting inequalities yield the uniform two-sided expansion E^down(u+tf)=E(u)+t integral fM(u)+o_B(|t|) on intrinsic energy sublevels. Original PL density and common mass retain every continuous direction.

Coercivity bounds a normalized maximizing net for a mass-V finite-D target mu. Its dual obstacle inequality and the uniform expansion with both signs give M(u_i)->mu weakly on the entire original continuous test space. Same-class approximation supplies genuine PL-theta maximizing sequences whose outputs are actual finite divisorial model measures retaining b_F.

Target-integral continuity is reconstructed rather than importing ample9.19. Write e=E/V, m=M/V, d_mu=D_mu/V and delta_mu(u)=d_mu-e(u)+integral u(mu/V). Midpoint strict energy concavity and the dual inequality give I(u,v)<=C_n(delta_mu(u)+delta_mu(v)). Choose PL-theta maximizers rho_j for mu with bounded normalized J. Holder control against continuous PL-theta phi, followed by M(rho_j)->mu, gives |integral phi(mu/V-m(psi))|<=K_{B,mu}sqrt(delta_mu(psi)) on bounded normalized J sets. Extend this to arbitrary intrinsic phi by the same-class approximation for the finite pair of targets mu and M(psi), both finite-D. At psi=rho_j, finite-divisorial-output integrals are continuous in original divisorial coordinates and converge uniformly on each compact intrinsic energy sublevel to the target integral. Thus the latter is continuous. Applying it also to max(u_i,u), with |u_i-u|=2(max(u_i,u)-u)-(u_i-u), proves target L1 continuity.

A genuine normalized maximizing sequence has an actual-function compact subnet. Weak energy usc and target-integral continuity prove attainment by an actual intrinsic E1 u. Both outer signs identify M(u)=mu against every original continuous test. Conversely the energy supporting inequality makes an output's potential attain its dual supremum. Raw mass V and finite intrinsic D, equivalently integrability of every original intrinsic E1 test, are therefore the exact solved target class.

For each original divisorial w, the common ample normalized cone has a finite lower evaluation bound, so D_theta(V delta_w)<=V T_M(w)<infinity independently of an inverse Dirac equation. If I(u,v)=0, choose PL-theta maximizers rho_j for that Dirac target. Holder control with test pair u,v and reference pair rho_j,0 gives integral(u-v)(m(rho_j)-delta_v0)=0. The intrinsic target estimate passes both tests to delta_w, giving equality of normalized divisorial values. Common-ample all-point determination proves equality everywhere, including poles. This proves I-nondegeneracy, uniqueness modulo constants and domination through the max argument.

The narrower theorem draft handles every actual nef and big rational L in the retained domain, on its entire original intrinsic E1, with reference zero, raw V=vol(L), genuine operators, comparison/domination, actual attainment and all-point uniqueness. It has no semiampleness, finite-generation, countability, toric, skeletal or support hypothesis. It remains an unverified proof draft relative to n1 and the listed published/classical premises. At x0=s0(v0), mu=delta_x0 has mixed mass one. Every genuine test u=q*psi satisfies u(x0)=sup psi. Since E_A(psi)<=sup psi, with equality for constants, its intrinsic mixed dual supremum is zero. Nevertheless mu is not a mixed output: Gauss graph points have |w|=1, whereas x0 has |w|=0. The graph is compact and closed. M_{L,H}(0)=delta_vX0 is a distinct original measure with identical pushforward and every genuine L-test integral.

Let f=r*f0, where f0(w)=max(0,min(1,-log|w|)), continuously extended by f0(0)=1 and f0(infinity)=0. Every analytic q-fiber has minimum zero and maximum one. Fiber-constant competitors give exactly P_L(tf)=0 for t>=0 and P_L(tf)=t for t<0. The degree-one outer energy has right slope zero and left slope one. For every nef L with L^n=0, positive bounded top/common-class products have zero mass and vanish. All intrinsic top energies and operators are zero on the whole genuine cone. For the entire numerical-zero class, the cone consists of constants even for actual bundles without effective representatives. For a defining net let C_i=u_i(v0)->C. Where epsilon A-B_i is ample, epsilon^{-1}(u_i-C_i) embeds in the normalized ample A cone, with divisorial value bounded below by finite M_v. Hence epsilon M_v<=u_i(v)-C_i<=0. A section of a cleared numerically trivial bundle has an effective divisor of zero ample intersection and is nowhere vanishing; section dimension is zero or one and volume is zero.
